stage: non-blind reconciliation and source-truth proposal authoring
author_role: Model annotator A, now a non-blind reconciliation author; not a third independent annotator, human expert, Harness executor or formal Judge.
review_state: Root adopted source observations and interpretation boundaries; no formal task or empirical difficulty claim.
source_boundary: Only the isolated seven-file source package and the two frozen A/B annotation directories were read. No author arrays, private SVG, plotting code, construction geometry or other tasks were accessed.
purpose: Domain meaning and evidence boundaries only.
task_nature: Original controlled fictional research record, not real model/human experiment.

business_concepts.completion: Mean/observed final target pass, expressed as percentage; figure-specific conditions remain bound.
business_concepts.budget: Total tool calls/task; F01 log positions encode multiplicative budgets.
business_concepts.uncertainty: F01/F02 SD describes batch spread, not proof of significance or equivalence.
business_concepts.elapsed_time: F03 representative ms under fixed hardware/timing conditions; does not measure final quality.
business_concepts.planning_length: F04 observational steps for distinct workloads and task distributions; does not identify an intervention effect.

method_paragraphs.E01: F01使用同一任务集、相同模型设置和统一最终目标谓词，两方法仅在图示总工具调用预算下汇总。每点是12个评估批次均值，误差棒为批次标准差。不同预算是不同设置，不是额外任务身份。没有发布配对差值、不确定性检验或其它条件下的外推实验。
method_paragraphs.E02: F02两方法在相同12个配对评估批次上运行，均值及标准差绘在图中。图中误差棒不是95%置信区间。未提供原始配对差值、协方差、显著性检验或预先设定的等效界；不能仅由误差棒交叠/不交叠确定显著或等效。
method_paragraphs.E03: F03同硬件和计时边界，仅记录图示worker设置下的耗时代表值。该图没有记录最终目标质量，也没有给出跨硬件或其它并发条件的保证。单位和轴尺度须实际读图。
method_paragraphs.E04: F04为观察性记录。每个点汇总一种不同工作负载，G1与G2来自不同任务分布；并非随机把同一任务分配到不同计划长度。没有控制所有混杂因素，没有因果干预试验。

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 预算10处两方法图示均值及同设置描述的边界
limits: Only the budget10 descriptive means under E01 same settings are claimed.
No significance, causal effect, unplotted budget or cross-task/hardware guarantee follows.
interpretations: Approximate72%/64% or compatible intervals within public tolerance, with budget10, correct methods and descriptive scope.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 由图上等距推出预算绝对增量相等
limits: Equal horizontal distances represent equal budget ratios on a log axis.
Compare labeled settings only; no invented intermediate experiment.
interpretations: Explain unequal absolute increments9 and90, or equivalent arithmetic using1/10/100 and log scale; equal factor10 is compatible.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 均值顺序和显示误差区间的交叠
limits: Overlap concerns displayed SD ranges on the percentage axis, not paired-difference confidence intervals.
B>A is a mean ordering, not a significance/equivalence result.
interpretations: Report B mean above A and SD overlap, with roughly80/84 and endpoints74–86/81–87, preserving percent/SD scope.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: “交叠已证明不显著且等效”的证据充分性断言
limits: Refuted applies to the claim that overlap has already proved non-significance and equality.
Actual significance and actual equivalence/equality remain unknown; no p-value, paired variance, equivalence bound or adverse experiment may be invented.
interpretations: State the evidence-sufficiency proposition is refuted/invalid while the underlying non-significance and equivalence facts are unknown.
A fact-targeted insufficient-evidence subassessment is meaningful only when clearly separated from the rejected “already proved” proposition.

limits: Approximate representative elapsed-time ratio at8 workers only, same hardware/timing boundary.
Read ms and logarithmic y values; no variability, throughput, quality or cross-hardware guarantee.
interpretations: About10x B/A from roughly3000/300 ms at8 workers; equivalent units may be converted explicitly, preserving the same ratio and conditions.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 从低耗时推出最终目标质量更高；主判断为质量事实是否可由现有证据确定
limits: The empirical final-quality comparison is unreported/unknown/insufficient.
The inference that lower latency alone is sufficient can be separately refuted if its judgment object is explicit.
Never infer A quality is worse, equal, zero or measured; F01/F02 pass rates are not bound to F03 worker8 quality.
interpretations: Quality-targeted insufficient/unknown/unreported is the primary factual result.
A reasoning-targeted refutation is legitimate when it explicitly targets “latency is sufficient to prove quality” and still records real quality as unknown.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 复合论述的组内方向与因果证据充分性；不是仅判断合并相关方向
limits: Retain pooled-positive support and within-both-groups-negative graphical counterevidence.
Do not relabel the whole compound claim insufficient while ignoring the visible within-group counterevidence.
The claim that causal proof exists is refuted as an evidential assertion; the real intervention effect remains unknown.
Observational negative within-group slopes do not establish a negative causal effect.
interpretations: Refute the compound overclaim through both per-group downward graphical trends and missing causal design; retain pooled-positive subclaim.
Treat real causal effect as unknown; group/workload distribution is a compatible confounding explanation, not a measured causal mechanism.

claim_boundaries.judgment_object: 合并/分组方向与现有观察的因果边界
limits: Pooled up and G1/G2 within-group down are descriptive directions, not a printed numeric correlation coefficient.
Cannot confirm a positive intervention effect does not prove zero or negative effect.
interpretations: Support the pooled/within-group direction reversal and limited causal conclusion, using actual groups/points and E04.

prohibited_inference_patterns: Do not infer absolute budget equality from equal log-axis pixel spacing.
Do not infer non-significance/equivalence solely from SD overlap.
Do not infer quality order from latency or borrow an unbound figure’s quality.
Do not infer causal effects from pooled or within-group observation slopes.
scope: No grade, score, operational acceptance rule or fixed label-frequency requirement is defined.

root_adoption.C04: Refute explicit proof-sufficiency; actual significance and equivalence remain unknown.
root_adoption.C06: Insufficient factual final-quality comparison; explicit refutation of low-latency-suffices metaclaim also admissible only while preserving actual lower latency and unknown quality.
root_adoption.C07: Do not erase within-group graphical counterevidence with generic uncertainty. Actual causal effect remains unknown.
root_adoption.absolute_author_paths: Historical provenance only; runtime uses the self-contained private evidence copies and source image hashes.
